title: conformance.View
description: The instance's own view of its connections.

hubIds.description: RegisterAck.hub_id of every hub this instance counts as registered (acknowledged) now

lastRejection.description: the latest Register refusal the library exposes (its status message at least), by any means: its API, or its log

retry.description: required: whether the library applies a retry policy to its sends (configured from CONFORMANCE_RETRY_*); false skips L1-RETRY, an absent value fails it
